queries_run: DexCom distribution channel shift pharmacy OR distributor OR direct-to-consumer 2026
DexCom business model transition subscription OR platform 2026

findings.claim: FY2025 10-K describes通路為北美及部分國際市場直銷團隊，輔以北美與數個國際市場的經銷安排；未描述結構性通路轉換。
findings.excerpt: To complement our direct sales efforts, we have entered into distribution arrangements in North America and several international markets that allow distributors to sell our products.

findings.claim: Q4 2025 財報電話會議摘要：管理層預期 Q1 2026 營收季減約 6-7%，部分歸因於逐步轉向藥局通路。
findings.source: MarketBeat, DexCom Q4 earnings call highlights

findings.claim: Q2 2026 call：Stelo 為針對非胰島素第 2 型糖尿病的 app 與平台；G7 15-Day 預計年底轉換約 50% 美國客戶。
findings.source: Webull, DexCom Q2 2026 Earnings Call Transcript
findings.excerpt: DexCom Flex Launch -- introduced in Germany as a 15-day sensor targeting the type 2 basal and non-insulin markets. G8 System Development -- targeted for late 2027 or early 2028, featuring a multi-analyte platform and a footprint half the size of the G7.
